## Before filing

CoralCake has a [deliberately narrow roadmap](../../ROADMAP.md). Some categories of features are explicitly out of scope (batch testing, A/B frameworks, custom eval marketplaces, recommendation engines) because they overlap with other products that do them better. If your idea is in that space, please make the case for why CoralCake specifically — or save us both some time.

## What problem are you trying to solve

Describe the situation you're in when you'd reach for this feature. The "why," not the "what."

## What does the feature look like

Your proposed solution. Sketch the UI flow if relevant.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways to solve the same problem, including "I do it manually now."

## Anything else

Links, related issues, prior art in other tools.
